Entity recognition and linking

Only lexicon names and aliases are linked. Numeric IDs identify entities; they carry no numerical meaning. Green highlights show linked spans. Orange spans have multiple candidates and remain unchanged. Text outside annotated spans stays unchanged. Pronouns and names outside the lexicon remain unresolved.

Blue spans are typed values. Their tokens point to structured annotations; value IDs are local to each row and kind. Qualifiers describe wording, not world truth. Ranges and unresolved numbers remain visible for review.

How to interpret this report

This is a deterministic preprocessing audit, not a truth classifier or a measured NER accuracy score. The report covers the complete practice dataset. A row with no linked mention may use a pronoun, an unlisted short name, or no named entity at all.

Offsets in the CSV are zero-based Python character offsets, with the end excluded. The registry preserves IDs when the lexicon is reordered or expanded.
